description: Competition, Bids & Dispatch is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Competitions, Bids & Dispatch Data " data table contains information of the competitions facilitated, bids received and dispatch instructions from the DPS platform. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Flexibility. Its keywords are Flexibility, Dispatch, Competitions, Bids. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
